summary: Create a live insertion-ordered Map key iterator.

semantics.live: additions before iterator completion may be visited

tests.name: delete and readd appends
tests.input: const m=new Map([['a',1],['b',2]]); const it=m.keys(); console.log(it.next().value); m.delete('b'); m.set('b',3); console.log(it.next().value);
tests.expected_behavior: prints a then b from the re-added entry
